title: Choose the visual world
question: The roll assigned The Weigh-In Card. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: The Weigh-In Card
options.lineage: Athletic-commission weigh-in sheets and official bout cards
options.thesis: Heroes are named fighters on an official card; you back one without stepping in the ring.
options.viewport: A full-bleed commission sheet: ranked fighter lane, BTC red / ETH blue corners, Deposit on each row, create-bot as a numbered margin sequence.
options.risk: Reads as sports kitsch if the form is not officious, or as a crypto dashboard if corner tape becomes badges.

raised.raise: The bout card is one ranked lane; each fighter is tagged with origin market and a ticket of record.
Create-bot is a numbered recoverable sequence in the margin; the depositor sheet stays the centered object.
Deposit shows a test-strip preview of shares before the wallet signs; the receipt is a fixed print.

options.label: The Racing Form
options.lineage: Daily Racing Form past-performance pages and paddock sheets
options.thesis: You do not ride. You study the card and put money on a horse.
options.viewport: A racing-form page: each horse is a Marketo hero, past races are BTC/ETH fights, the bet slip is Deposit.
options.risk: Also the direction most runs in this category land on: backing without fighting is the most literal depositor story.

options.label: Bazaar Spread
options.lineage: Harper’s Bazaar under Brodovitch: Didot hairlines across a gutter
options.thesis: A hero poses on the left page; the vault and Deposit answer across the gutter.
options.viewport: Two-page spread: left a named hero with record, right the vault NAV and Deposit; BTC/ETH as the opposing gesture.
options.case: Holds product clarity as pose/answer; loses identification — fashion magazine is not how fight-backers see themselves.
options.risk: Didot luxury can make event-market vaults feel like a perfume ad.

options.label: Hoffmann Lattice
options.lineage: Wiener Werkstätte metalwork showroom: punched-square silver lattices
options.thesis: Each hero is a square cell; idle stays pierced open, Deposit fills it solid black.
options.viewport: A punched lattice of hero cells; BTC and ETH as two nested caskets; the filled cell is the live back.
options.case: Holds clarity as a scannable roster; loses identification — Viennese metalwork is not the depositor’s world.
options.risk: The lattice can collapse into a generic bento grid and lose the punch.

options.label: HyperCard Stack
options.lineage: HyperCard shoebox stacks: browse and author are two modes of one card
options.thesis: Each hero is one card; Browse is deposit, Author is create-bot.
options.viewport: A shoebox of hero cards; the current card shows record and vault; painted buttons flip Browse or Author.
options.case: Two modes of one object nail depositor vs bot-creator; loses identification — 1987 Mac is not a 2026 wallet.
options.risk: One-bit can read as ironic retro, not a place to put USDso.

options.label: Moon-shadow bazaar
options.lineage: A night bazaar where merchants trade shadows by length and origin
options.thesis: Heroes as stalls selling the shadow of a fight; depositors wander the lane.
options.viewport: A vertical moonlit lane of hero stalls, each tagged with origin and length.
options.case: Loses both axes: traders do not identify with trading shadows, and vault deposit vanishes into metaphor.
options.kept: One ranked lane of comparable goods, each tagged with origin.
options.risk: Surreal commerce hides the wallet action.

options.label: Orizuru sequence
options.lineage: A vermilion washi square becoming a crane through thirty-two numbered folds
options.thesis: The product unfolds as a recoverable crease sequence.
options.viewport: A square sheet with numbered margin folds; the finished crane is a hero.
options.case: Loses both axes: origami is not this audience, and a 32-step sequence buries deposit-without-a-bot.
options.kept: Numbered recoverable sequence in the margin, not a modal wizard.

options.label: Darkroom bay
options.lineage: A printing darkroom under amber safelight: expose, develop, fix
options.thesis: A hero’s record develops in the tray; deposit is the exposure.
options.viewport: Stations in order: compose the hero, expose the deposit, develop the receipt.
options.case: Loses both axes: darkroom printers are not depositors, and chemical irreversibility fights a rejectable wallet tx.
options.kept: Test-strip preview before commit; the receipt is a fixed print.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: What a DeFi event-market landing always ships, executed at full craft.
canonCard.viewport: Dark hero headline, dual CTAs, three feature cards, a TVL ticker, footer.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from the competition by design.
